guesses.reason: Broad bear-like head, thick double coat, erect triangular ears, plush curled tail over the back, and classic pinto black-and-white pattern with a white blaze are all hallmark American Akita traits.

guesses.breed: Akita mix (with Siberian Husky or other spitz)
guesses.reason: The ears are slightly larger and the muzzle a bit longer than a typical show Akita, hinting at possible spitz-type mixing.
Heavy-boned build, dense coat, and plumed tail overlap with Malamute features, though the pattern and head shape favor Akita.

breed.appearance: A large, heavy-boned spitz-type dog with a thick double coat in a pinto pattern: a mostly black head and face with a narrow white blaze on the forehead and a white stripe down one side of the muzzle, a white chest, legs, and paws, and a black saddle with a white band behind the shoulders. He has erect, thick triangular ears tipped slightly forward, small deep-set warm brown eyes with a soulful expression, a broad black nose, and some graying around the muzzle suggesting a mature age. His fluffy cream-white tail curls up high over his back.
breed.fun_fact: Akitas are famously loyal, and the legendary Akita Hachiko waited faithfully for his owner at a Tokyo train station for nearly ten years!
